result.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
result.summary: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices. In this work, we investigate how to effectively mix residual streams within the Birkhoff polytope. We reveal a mixing trade-off: when under-mixed residual matrices stay close to the vertices of the Birkhoff polytope, hyper-connections will degenerate into a set of nearly independent streams; when over-mixed residual matrices are concentrated around the uniform barycenter of the polytope, streams will become less distinguishable from each other. We theoretically validate our findings by bounding the cumulative residual mixing, stream difference and gradient difference of mixing coefficients across layers. Motivated by these findings, we propose Contraction for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (cmHC), an exact doubly stochastic method which geometrically contracts the Birkhoff polytope toward its interior. This contraction mitigates under-mixing by forcing the residual matrices to explore deeper into the polytope, with a provable stream mixing bound and no new parameterization. Moreover, we apply a moderate contraction at the shallow layers to prevent over-mixing, enabling stable gradient propagation on extremely large-scale model pretraining. Extensive experiments across dense and mixture-of-experts models at various parameter scales demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of cmHC. We also develop fused operators for cmHC on Ascend NPUs, reducing hyper-connection execution latency by up to 44.8%.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 manifold-constrained hyper-connections 中多残差流混合的「欠混合趋近多面体顶点、过混合趋近均匀重心」权衡，提出将 Birkhoff 多面体向内部几何收缩的 cmHC，给出累积混合、流差异与梯度差异的界，并在稠密与 MoE 大模型预训练及 Ascend NPU 融合算子上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 多流残差矩阵的双随机约束、混合程度上界与浅层适度收缩，可能为 latent 推理中多路状态的混合与更新、以及流之间可区分性（信息坍缩）提供可供核查的方法线索；但原文面向预训练稳定性，不涉及视觉推理证据。
